_comment: Tool manifest read by setup-tools.sh on container boot.
Vibekit ships this with all entries 'enabled: false'. The Settings -> Tools
panel surfaces them as Enable/Delete buttons. Feature surfaces (MCP add
modal, Git Sources sub-tab) auto-install the relevant subset on intent.
Sections: runtimes, binary, go, npm, pip, custom, cargo, lsp, apt.
enabled       bool   gates install (defaults true if omitted)
auto_update   bool   apply upstream version bumps on boot (defaults true)
requires      []str  section.name deps installed before this entry
shims         {n:c}  wrapper scripts created in $BIN as 'exec <c>'
uninstall     str    optional cleanup override (otherwise section default)
probe         str    custom 'is installed' file path
kiro-cli is downloaded separately by entrypoint.sh (licensing).
git, jq, curl, ca-certificates, openssh-client, unzip, xz-utils are baked
into the image as the minimal runtime surface.

node.description: Node.js runtime (LTS). Required for npx-based MCP servers and npm-installed LSPs (typescript-language-server, pyright). ~100 MB.

go.description: Go toolchain. Required for gopls LSP and Go-based MCP servers. ~190 MB.

java.description: OpenJDK 21 JRE (Eclipse Temurin). Required for jdtls (Java LSP) and kotlin-language-server. ~190 MB; shared between the two LSPs.
java.install: mkdir -p ${RUNTIMES}/java && tag_url='${VERSION}' && safe_tag=$(printf '%s' "${VERSION}" | sed 's/+/%2B/g') && curl -fsSL "https://github.com/adoptium/temurin21-binaries/releases/download/${safe_tag}/OpenJDK21U-jre_${ARCH_X86_64_OR_AARCH64}_linux_hotspot_$(printf '%s' "${VERSION}" | sed 's/jdk-//;s/+/_/').tar.gz" | tar -xz -C ${RUNTIMES}/java --strip-components=1

ruby.description: Ruby runtime via apt. Required for solargraph LSP and Ruby MCP servers. ~120 MB. Note: this installs system-wide via apt-get, not under /config/tools/runtimes.
ruby.install: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ruby ruby-bundler ruby-dev && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

rust.description: Rust toolchain (rustup + rustc + cargo). Required for full rust-analyzer functionality and Rust MCP servers. ~150 MB.
rust.install: curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | RUSTUP_HOME=${RUNTIMES}/rust CARGO_HOME=${RUNTIMES}/rust sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --profile minimal --no-modify-path

uv.description: Python tool runner (uv from Astral). Brings its own Python; provides uvx for kiro-cli's Python MCP servers (fetch, git, time, sentry, etc.). ~50 MB.

yq.description: Command-line YAML processor. Useful for editing Kubernetes/Helm/CI YAML in agent-driven workflows.

gh.description: GitHub CLI. Auto-installed when you add a GitHub account in Sources, used for PR creation, repo cloning, and authenticated git operations.

glab.description: GitLab CLI. Auto-installed when you add a GitLab account in Sources.

tea.description: Gitea/Codeberg CLI. Auto-installed when you add a Gitea or Codeberg account in Sources.

typescript-language-server.description: TypeScript / JavaScript LSP (Microsoft canonical, npm-installed). Requires Node runtime. Use this for full tsc compatibility; pick tsgo below for ~10x faster type-checking on most code.

tsgo.description: TypeScript native preview (tsgo from Microsoft, Go-compiled). Single ~14 MB binary, no Node runtime needed. Shimmed as typescript-language-server for kiro-cli compatibility. Use this for speed; pick typescript-language-server above for 100% tsc fidelity.

pyright.description: Python LSP (Microsoft official, npm-installed). Requires Node runtime. Use this for full pyright fidelity; pick pyrefly below for native speed.

pyrefly.description: Python LSP (Meta's pyrefly, native Rust binary). Single ~18 MB binary, no Node runtime needed. Shimmed as pyright/pyright-langserver for kiro-cli compatibility. ~95% diagnostic-equivalent to Microsoft's pyright; pick pyright above for full fidelity.

gopls.description: Go LSP (gopls). Installed via 'go install'. Requires Go runtime.

rust-analyzer.description: Rust LSP. Standalone ~50 MB binary; runs without Cargo, but enabling runtimes.rust unlocks full project analysis (cargo metadata, etc.).

clangd.description: C/C++ LSP. Standalone ~160 MB binary (largest LSP). Looks for compile_commands.json in your workspace for project understanding.
clangd.install: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && curl -fsSL -o $tmp/clangd.zip https://github.com/clangd/clangd/releases/download/${VERSION}/clangd-linux-${VERSION}.zip && unzip -q $tmp/clangd.zip -d $tmp && cp $tmp/clangd_${VERSION}/bin/clangd ${BIN}/clangd && chmod 755 ${BIN}/clangd && rm -rf $tmp

jdtls.description: Java LSP (Eclipse JDT). ~52 MB plus shared OpenJDK 21 JRE (~190 MB). Tree-sitter mode without this provides basic symbol search and pattern matching for Java code.

kotlin-language-server.description: Kotlin LSP. ~94 MB plus shared OpenJDK 21 JRE. Reuses the same JVM as jdtls if both are enabled.
kotlin-language-server.install:
tmp=$(mktemp -d) && curl -fsSL -o $tmp/kls.zip https://github.com/fwcd/kotlin-language-server/releases/download/${VERSION}/server.zip && unzip -q $tmp/kls.zip -d ${TOOLS}/lib/ && rm -rf $tmp && rm -rf ${TOOLS}/lib/kotlin-language-server && mv ${TOOLS}/lib/server ${TOOLS}/lib/kotlin-language-server && printf '#!/bin/sh
export JAVA_HOME=${RUNTIMES}/java
exec ${TOOLS}/lib/kotlin-language-server/bin/kotlin-language-server "$@"
' > ${BIN}/kotlin-language-server && chmod 755 ${BIN}/kotlin-language-server

solargraph.description: Ruby LSP. Installed as a Ruby gem. Requires the Ruby runtime (~120 MB combined).
